title: Materialize fail-closed FA3 License & Rights Management
decision: Use Apache-2.0 as the default license for FA3-original work unless a narrower file/component marker explicitly states otherwise.
Never infer that FA3 licensing changes third-party licenses, model terms, dataset terms, asset rights, service terms or output-use rights.
Use SPDX identifiers and SPDX/CycloneDX release evidence rather than an FA3-private license vocabulary.
Bind license-rights enforcement into the existing Software Supply Chain / Security Governance authority instead of creating a new top-level architectural authority.
Block release eligibility until the pre-existing repository has completed a retroactive rights audit.
